entries.name: Downy Blossom
entries.flavor: Soft enough that the wind decides which way it faces.
entries.notes: The annotated entry of this partition; the three below show the same shape with less commentary. Four things in it are the whole pattern. (1) `role` is the frame-NEUTRAL role id from core.v1.json roles.list — `head-guard`, never the plant display word `crown` and never ssot-item-categories.md's stale `head-protective`. (2) The id uses the OPPOSITE convention: `item.{frame}-{frameRoleName}-{band}-{seq:03}` takes core.v1.json's `plantName` verbatim, which is why the id says `crown` and the field says `head-guard`. Both are correct; they are different columns. (3) `class` is a class-LADDER RUNG id from classes.v1.json (`fibre` `husk` `bark` `heartwood` on armour/plant), not the ladder name `armour`. (4) `implicit.family` must be on this role's slate in classes.v1.json implicitSlates.head-guard — today that slate is exactly atom.vitality and atom.mending, and it is explicitly a stopgap: every family ssot-equip-slots.md names for this role is stat.derived and quarantined until E12. Nothing here is a magnitude: `powerBand` names a band from bands.v1.json powerBand.enum and the base-stat / implicit tier ladder is generated from it.

entries.name: Crackling Rosette
entries.flavor: It talks in the heat. Nobody has worked out what about.
entries.notes: Variation is the point of a partition, and this entry carries all of it at once: the weakest implicit band on the slate paid back with the highest socket ceiling, a `fragile` durability read, and the `husk` rung rather than `fibre`. Three rules it is worth seeing obeyed. Tags: one tag per EXCLUSIVE axis — `light` (mass-class), `organic` (material-nature), `rooted` (origin), `fragile` (durability-class), `defensive` (combat-posture) are five different axes, so they combine; adding `medium` beside `light` would reject. An exclusive axis may also be omitted entirely, as entries 001 and 002 omit durability-class. Words: the adjective comes from classRungAdjectivePools['armour.plant.husk'] and the noun from nounPools['head-guard.plant'], both in words.v1.json; a base-type partition may NOT reach into themeAdjectivePools, conceptPools or uniqueSetSeedPools, because a base type has a class and no theme. Pattern: `compound` (<Adjective> <Base>) is what every entry here uses — `of-construct` needs a Concept, and concepts are theme-owned, so it is effectively closed to base types. `socketMax` is a structural count and therefore authored; every magnitude behind it is not.
